lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: I'm Lucy Ford. I'm a pastry chef at a bakery on Tennyson Street, and I grew up in Manchester, in England.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: I'm Ravi Kapoor. I'm a software engineer, and I am the reason this house has a fire extinguisher.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: I'm Owen Brooks. I'm a physical therapist, and I'm the only one here who ever does the dishes.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Okay, house meeting. Item one. Ravi, the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Why is it always me?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Because of the fire.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: One fire. One time. February 2024. I was making my mom's recipe for pakoras, I had the oil way too hot, and I turned around for one second to answer a call from my brother Neil in London. When I turned back, the whole pan was on fire. So I threw a wet towel on it, which, it turns out, is exactly the wrong thing to do.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: I came downstairs and the smoke alarm was screaming, and Ravi was just standing there holding a burning towel like a torch. I grabbed the lid off the big soup pot, slammed it down on the pan, and that was that. The ceiling above the stove is still a little bit brown.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: The landlord still doesn't know.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: And he never will.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: How long have we even lived in this house on Pearl Street? Since 2023?

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: We moved in in 2022. August, right during that awful heat wave.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: No, it was 2023. I was still working at the old bakery in 2022.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: I really think it was 2022.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: I moved in a month after you two, so don't look at me.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Item two. Trivia. The Know It Alls came in fourth on Tuesday, which is unacceptable.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: That's because Ben didn't show up. Ben Carter is our only music person.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Ben and I used to date, you know. From 2020 to 2022. It was fine. We're much better as teammates.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Everyone in this friend group has dated everyone.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Ha, true. Hannah Kim and I met in 2017, at the climbing gym, we dated for years, and now I'm helping plan her wedding.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: That's very mature of you.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: I'm a very mature man. I tore my ACL on a green run.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Speaking of weddings, I just got back from my cousin's wedding. Arjun Mehta and Claire Dunn, in Napa, last weekend.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: It was beautiful. The whole thing was in a vineyard, and Arjun's college roommate Chris gave a speech about a kettle that I still don't fully understand. Then my brother Neil flew in from London as a surprise, and my aunt cried so hard she had to sit down. I danced for five hours straight. My knees still hurt.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Do you want me to look at your knees?

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: No. I want sympathy.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Okay, item three is mine. My sister Jessica Brooks is coming to visit from Portland next weekend. Can she have the couch?

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Of course. Oh, but my manager Jessica Long is coming over Saturday to drop off the keys to the bakery van. So we'll have two Jessicas in the house.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: I cannot handle two Jessicas.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Does Jessica like spicy food? I'm making dinner on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: You are not making dinner.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: No more frying. That's a house rule now.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Okay. Fine. Takeout.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Item four. Owen, are you going on the Eldorado trip with the Sunday Sends crew?

lines.speaker: Owen Brooks
lines.text: Yes, in two weeks. Me, Sam, Hannah, and Kevin. We're going back to the Bastille Crack, which Sam and I failed on last year. I've been training on the hangboard every single night, which is why you hear that thumping through the wall at eleven.

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: So that's what that is.

lines.speaker: Lucy Ford
lines.text: Okay, meeting adjourned. Who wants tea?

lines.speaker: Ravi Kapoor
lines.text: Me. And I'll stay far away from the stove.

events.name: Move into the Pearl Street house
Arjun and Claire's wedding in Napa
